description: Drop-in AI chatbot for any website — React widget + server-side ChatBot client. 10 LLM providers with auto-failover, markdown knowledge base, URL-only payment/scheduling adapters. npm: chatbotlite. Apache-2.0.
rules: Server import is `chatbotlite/client` for ChatBot; `chatbotlite/node` for knowledgeFromFile; `chatbotlite/react` for ChatWidget; `chatbotlite/adapters` for URL adapters.
ChatBot constructor: new ChatBot({ knowledge, providers: { keys, chain } }). knowledge is a required markdown string.
Providers use an ordered failover chain (chain: [{ provider, model }]). There is no per-message routing option.
bot.replyStream(message, { history }) returns a ReadableStream for an SSE route (Content-Type: text/event-stream).
No vector DB — knowledge is one markdown file.
